description: Eight selected giant statues, from shortest to tallest on one shared height scale. Approximate figure heights exclude separate architectural pedestals and lotus thrones. This is a curated selection, not an exhaustive world ranking. All statue illustrations were generated using Cloudflare FLUX.2 Klein 4B at its fixed 4 steps, then cut out locally. These are AI illustrations and can differ from the actual monuments; sourced measurements do not certify image accuracy. No narration or soundtrack. #Statues #SizeComparison #Shorts Spring Temple Buddha uses an estimated 108 m figure-only height (128 m published including its 20 m lotus throne); reported dimensions can vary by definition.
